blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: U.S. employment-discrimination complaints describe complex event sequences that are not explicitly captured by lexical or embedding-based representations alone. We present ARGUS, a source-grounded pipeline that combines a 5W1H-inspired schema, legal-domain models, and LLM-based structured generation to construct document-level Event Knowledge Graphs (EKGs) from CourtListener complaints. ARGUS extracts fact-bearing statements, builds chunk-level event graphs with participant, temporal, and causal structure, and merges them into document-level representations. We evaluate graph quality through human and multi-model assessment and test downstream utility on claim classification and legal QA. The graph-structured classifier outperforms raw and linearized baselines on the held-out set, and EKG-only retrieval improves document-scoped QA, while open-retrieval gains remain limited by low first-stage candidate recall. These results suggest that EKGs are most useful for organizing and reasoning over evidence once relevant material has been retrieved.
blocks.zh: 美国的就业歧视投诉描述了复杂的事件序列,这些序列并非仅由词汇或嵌入式表述所明确反映. 我们提出ARGUS, 由源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源源流, ARGUS提取包含事实的陈述,与参与者建立块级事件图表,时间和因果结构,并将其合并为文件级表述. 我们通过人类和多模式评估来评估图表质量,并测试下游对索赔分类和法律质量保证的效用。 图形结构的分类器在被搁置的组合上超过了原始的和线性化的基线,只有EKG的检索改进了文档范围QA,而开放检索的收益仍然受到低一级候选人召回的限制. 这些结果表明,一旦有关材料被检索出来,EKG对于组织和推理证据最为有用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Legal practitioners often need to interpret and compare cases whose
underlying events are similar even when described differently. Lexical and embedding-based retrieval methods can identify semantically relevant passages, but return largely unstructured text and do not explicitly represent who did what to whom, when, and why . This structure is important in legal narratives, where participant roles and temporal or causal relations can determine whether two cases are meaningfully comparable.
blocks.zh:
法律从业者往往需要解释和比较其法律从业者:
基本事件相似,即使描述不同。 基于文字和嵌入式的检索方法可以识别出与内容相关的段落,但返回的文本基本上没有结构,并且没有明确代表谁对谁、何时、为何这样做。 这种结构在法律叙述中很重要,在法律叙述中,参与者的角色和时间或因果关系可以决定两个案例是否具有有意义的可比性.

blocks.en: We study this problem in U.S. employment-discrimination complaints. We present ARGUS, a pipeline that converts complaint narratives into source-grounded Event Knowledge Graphs (EKGs). Rather than representing a case only as text or a set of entities, ARGUS models events together with their participants, legal roles, source evidence, and supported temporal and causal relations.
blocks.zh: 我们在美国就业歧视投诉中研究这个问题。 我们介绍ARGUS, 将投诉叙述转换为源源事件知识图的管道。 ARGUS模型与其仅作为案文或一组实体代表案件,不如与其参与者一起进行活动,发挥法律作用,提供证据,并支持时间和因果关系。

blocks.en: ARGUS follows a staged construction process. Starting from CourtListener complaints, 1 1 1 https://www.courtlistener.com/ it identifies fact-bearing statements, groups them into semantic chunks, extracts chunk-level event graphs using a 5W1H-inspired representation ( Hamborg et al., 2019 ) , and merges them into a document-level EKG through deterministic and LLM-assisted cross-chunk resolution. Figure 1 provides an overview; implementation and evaluation details are given in Section 3 and the Appendix.
blocks.zh: ARGUS采用分阶段施工程序。 从法庭听取者的投诉开始,11 1 https://www.courtlistener.com/通过确定性和LLM协助的跨圆解析,将陈述分为语义块,利用5W1H启发式代表法提取块级事件图表(Hamborg等人,2019年),并将其合并为文件级的EKG。 图1提供了概览;第3节和附录提供了执行情况和评价的详细情况。

blocks.zh: 图 1:从联邦就业歧视投诉叙述中为EKG建设提供多阶段管道.

blocks.en: We investigate three questions: (i) Can the staged pipeline produce reliable, source-grounded legal event graphs? (ii) Do these graphs improve legal classification and document-scoped question answering relative to text-based representations? (iii) Do these benefits extend to external and open-retrieval legal QA settings?
blocks.zh: 我们调查三个问题:(一) 分阶段管道能否产生可靠、有源源的法律事件图表? (二) 这些图表相对于文本表述而言,是否改进了法律分类和文件范围的问题回答? (三) 这些福利是否扩大到外部和开放性的法律质量保证环境?

blocks.en: We evaluate graph construction at multiple stages, including fact extraction, chunk-level graph extraction, and document-level merging, using automatic measures, human annotation, and multi-model judging. We then assess downstream utility through claim-type classification and document-scoped FAQ question answering, followed by bar-exam experiments testing generalization to multiple-choice QA and open retrieval. Exploratory case-clustering analyses are reported in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们在多个阶段评估图表构建, 包括事实提取,块级图表提取, 以及文件级的合并, 使用自动测量,人文注释,以及多模型判断。 然后,我们通过权利要求类型分类和文件范围FAQ问题回答评估下游的效用,然后进行巴-Exam实验,测试对多选择QA的概括和开放检索。 附录C报告了探索性案例分组分析。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. (1) We introduce a source-grounded, role-aware EKG pipeline for U.S. employment-discrimination complaints that represents events with participant, temporal, and causal structure. (2) We introduce a multi-stage evaluation protocol for legal event graphs, combining human annotation with complementary automatic and LLM-based evaluation. 2 2 2 The human annotations will be released upon publication. (3) We show that the graph-structured classifier outperforms raw and linearized baselines on held-out claim classification and that EKG-based retrieval improves document-scoped QA; in open retrieval, gains remain limited when relevant evidence is absent from the first-stage candidate set.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 (1) 我们为美国就业歧视投诉引入了一个基于来源、具有作用意识的EKG管道,代表了参与者、时间和因果关系。 (2)我们引入了法律事件图表的多阶段评价协议,将人的注释与辅助性自动和基于LLM的评价相结合. 2个 2个 2 人的说明将在出版后公布。 (3)我们显示,图表结构的分类器在搁置索赔分类上超过了原始和线性化基线,基于EKG的检索改进了文件范围质量控制;在公开检索中,当第一阶段候选者没有相关证据时,收益仍然有限。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: ARGUS intersects three lines of work: legal retrieval and representation, event extraction and temporal reasoning, and graph-augmented retrieval.
blocks.zh: ARGUS跨越三条工作线:法律检索和陈述、事件提取和时间推理以及图解检索。

blocks.en: Legal case retrieval has progressed from lexical matching toward neural interaction and representation learning ( Feng et al., 2024 ) . BERT-PLI models paragraph-level interactions between cases ( Shao et al., 2020 ) , while legal-domain models such as LEGAL-BERT ( Chalkidis et al., 2020 ) and models trained on LeXFiles ( Chalkidis et al., 2023 ) provide domain-adapted representations for legal NLP. The reasoning-focused legal retrieval benchmark used in our bar-exam experiments separates retrieval quality from downstream answer selection ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 法律案例的检索已经从词汇匹配发展到神经相互作用和表现学习(冯等人,2024年)。 BERT-PLI模型在案件之间的段落层次互动(Shao等人,2020年),而LAL-BERT(Chalkidis等人,2020年)和LeXFiles(Chalkidis等人,2023年)培训的模型等法律领域模型为合法的NLP提供了适合域的说明. 我们的bar-exam实验中使用的注重推理的法律检索基准将检索质量与下游的答案选择区分开来(郑等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: General information-extraction systems such as DyGIE++ ( Wadden et al., 2019 ) , MetaGraph ( Pedinotti et al., 2026 ) and OneIE ( Lin et al., 2020 ) jointly model entities, relations, and/or events. In the legal domain, Filtz et al. (2020) extract event types, participants, and temporal information from ECHR decisions, while LexTime evaluates temporal ordering of event pairs in U.S. federal complaints ( Barale et al., 2025 ) . The 5W1H framework provides a compact representation of core event information ( Hamborg et al., 2019 ) . REGen combines exact, relaxed, and LLM-based matching for generative event-argument evaluation and validates these measures against human judgments ( Sharif et al., 2025 ) . ARGUS applies a 5W1H-inspired schema to source-grounded mini-graphs and merges them into document-level EKGs with legal participant roles and temporal and causal relations.
blocks.zh: 一般信息采集系统如DyGIE++(Wadden等人,2019年),MetaGraph (Pedinotti等人,2026年)和OneIE(Lin等人,2020年)联合建模实体,关系和/或事件. 在法律领域,Filtz等人(2020年)从欧洲人权法院的裁决中提取事件类型、参与者和时间信息,而LexTime则在美国联邦申诉中评价事件对的时间顺序(Barale等人,2025年)。 5W1H框架提供了核心事件信息的紧凑表现(Hamborg等人,2019年). REGen将精确、宽松和基于LLM的匹配用于基因事件-论证评价,并验证这些措施与人类判断(Sharif等人,2025年)。 ARGUS将5W1H启发式计划应用于基于源的迷你图,并将其合并为文件级的EKG,具有法律参与者角色以及时间和因果关系.

blocks.en: Li et al. (2024) construct a Chinese legal knowledge graph from criminal-law materials using a knowledge-enhanced LLM. More broadly, GraphRAG constructs entity-based graph representations for query-focused summarization ( Edge et al., 2024 ) , while KG 2 RAG uses knowledge-graph relations to expand and organize retrieved chunks ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . EventRAG builds event knowledge graphs for multi-event reasoning ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . In the legal domain, Kordjamshidi et al. (2026) investigate structured representations and their efficacy in tax-law reasoning for QA, and LegalGraphRAG ( Chen et al., 2026 ) combines hierarchical legal graphs with multi-agent retrieval and verification. ARGUS instead focuses on source-grounded, document-level EKGs for U.S. employment-discrimination complaints, preserving legal participant roles and temporal and causal relations through staged document-level merging.
blocks.zh: 李等编. (2024)利用知识增强的LLM从刑法材料中构建中国法律知识图. 更广泛地说,GraphRAG构建基于实体的图表表示,用于以查询为重点的汇总(Edge等人,2024年),而KG 2 RAG则使用知识-图关系来扩展和组织检索块(Zhu等人,2025年)。 EventRAG为多事件推理构建事件知识图(Yang等人,2025年). 在法律领域,Kordjamshidi等人(2026年)调查结构化陈述及其在税法推理中对QA的效力,LegalGraphRAG(Chen等人,2026年)将等级法图与多代理检索与核实相结合. 相反,ARGUS侧重于美国就业歧视投诉的基于源的、文件级的EKG,通过分阶段的文件级合并,保持法律参与者的作用以及时间和因果关系。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: ARGUS converts the FACTS narrative of a U.S. employment-discrimination complaint into a source-grounded, document-level Event Knowledge Graph (EKG). The pipeline has four stages: (1) sentence-level fact extraction, (2) semantic chunking, (3) two-stage mini-graph extraction, and (4) deterministic and LLM-assisted document-level merging. Figure 1 summarizes the pipeline. We evaluate each component separately to distinguish errors introduced during fact selection, event and relation extraction, and graph merging.
blocks.zh: ARGUS将美国就业歧视投诉的FACTS描述转换为基于来源的文件级事件知识图。 管道分为四个阶段:(1) 句子一级的事实提取,(2) 语义分类,(3) 两级小型图提取,(4) 确定性和LLM辅助文件一级合并。 图1汇总了管道。 我们分别评价每个部分,以区分在事实选择、事件和关系提取以及图表合并过程中引入的错误。

blocks.en: We define facts as event-bearing statements describing concrete actions, communications, decisions, or outcomes, distinguishing them from procedural or rhetorical text. Each sentence s s is classified as Fact or Non-Fact using a fine-tuned LEGAL-BERT or LexLM encoder ( Chalkidis et al., 2020 ; Chalkidis et al., 2023 ) . Let p ⁡ ( s ) p(s) denote the classifier’s maximum softmax probability. Predictions above a confidence threshold τ \tau are retained directly; sentences with p ⁡ ( s ) < τ p(s)<\tau are passed to an LLM, which returns the identifiers of sentences judged to be facts. Only sentences ultimately labeled as facts are passed to graph construction.
blocks.zh: 我们把事实定义为包含事件的声明,说明具体行动、通信、决定或结果,将其与程序性或修辞性案文区分开来。 每一句 s 被归类为事实或非事实,使用微调的法律-BERT或LexLM编码器(Chalkidis等人,2020年;Chalkidis等人,2023年)。 让 p QQ( s ) p 表示分类者的最大软度概率 。 超过信任阈值的预测\\ tau被直接保留; 带有 p\\ (s) < p(s)\ tau的句子被传递给 LLM, 它返回被判断为事实的句子的标识符 。 只有最终被贴上事实标签的句子才被转到图表构造.

blocks.en: Retained fact sentences preserve their original identifiers and are formatted as sentence-labeled input ( [S1] , [S2] , …). An LLM groups them into coherent event sequences, topics, or narrative phases. The prompt favors boundaries associated with changes in theme, time, or actor, avoids splitting an event across chunks, requires coverage of all retained sentences, and introduces approximately two to three sentences of overlap.
blocks.zh: 保留的事实句保留其原始标识符,并格式化为句标输入([S1],[S2],. 一个LLM将其组合成连贯的事件序列,主题或叙事阶段. 即时偏好与主题、时间或角色变化有关的界限,避免将一个事件分割成块,要求涵盖所有保留句子,并引入大约两到三句重叠。

blocks.en: ARGUS uses a 5W1H-inspired representation ( Hamborg et al., 2019 ) within a structured event-extraction formulation ( Srivastava et al., 2025 ) . Entity records contain an identifier, name, entity kind, canonical legal role, and optional aliases. Event records contain an identifier, event type, main verb, trigger, participants, temporal information, source evidence, and confidence. Participants reference entity identifiers and carry event-specific roles, while evidence retains supporting sentence identifiers.
blocks.zh: ARGUS在结构化的事件-提取制剂中采用了5W1H激发的表示法(Hamborg等人,2019年) (Srivastava等人,2025年). 实体记录包含识别符,名称,实体类型,犬科法律角色,以及可选别名. 事件记录包含识别符,事件类型,主动词,触发符,参与者,时间信息,源证据,以及信心. 参与者参考实体标识符并带有事件特定角色,而证据保留支持句子标识符.

blocks.en: Temporal information may be explicit, relative, or unknown, following the broader problem of event-pair temporal relation modeling ( Ning et al., 2018 ) . The extraction schema supports before , after , overlap , and same-time temporal relations and causes , enables , and prevents causal relations. ARGUS retains relations only when supported by the source text. For graph-based classification, events and participant entities become nodes; event–entity edges represent participation, and temporal and causal relations remain event–event edges. An example extracted mini-graph is shown in Appendix A , Figure 4 ; the full downstream GNN architecture is provided in Appendix B.3 .
blocks.zh: 时间信息可能是在事件-时间关系建模的更广泛问题之后,明确,相对,或未知的(Ning等人,2018年). 提取计划支持在 , 之后, 重叠, 以及同时时间的关系和原因, 能够, 并防止因果关系。 ARGUS仅在源文本支持的情况下才保留关系. 对于基于图表的分类,事件和参与者实体成为节点;事件-实体边缘代表参与,时间和因果关系仍然是事件-活动边缘. 附录A,图4显示了提取的小型图;附录B.3提供了完整的下游GNN架构。

blocks.en: Each chunk is processed through two structured-generation stages. Stage 1 extracts grounded entities and events and is explicitly instructed not to produce temporal or causal edges. Stage 2 receives the original chunk and the complete Stage 1 JSON output and adds only source-supported temporal and causal relations. Both stages require strict JSON, preservation of sentence identifiers, and no unsupported entities, events, dates, or relations.
blocks.zh: 每个块经过两个结构化生成阶段处理. 第1阶段抽取被禁足的实体和事件,并明确指示不要产生时间或因果边缘. 第2阶段接收原始块和完整的第1阶段JSON输出,只添加源支持的时间和因果关系. 这两个阶段都需要严格的JSON,保留句子识别符,并且没有不支持的实体,事件,日期或关系.

blocks.en: The extraction configuration is optimized with GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . A candidate specifies the Stage 1 and Stage 2 models, prompts, retry instructions, and extraction settings. Candidates are evaluated using structural checks—including schema validity, reference integrity, temporal and causal consistency, and coverage—together with an LLM judge that scores factual accuracy, completeness, relevance, faithfulness, coherence, and overall quality. Cost is measured using token counts when available and API-call count otherwise. GEPA uses the metrics and observed failures to propose mutations and retains non-dominated configurations on a quality–cost Pareto frontier. The two-stage extractor and GEPA optimization loop are shown in Appendix Figures 2 and 3 .
blocks.zh: 提取配置与GEPA优化(Agrawal等人,2026年). 候选人指定了第1阶段和第2阶段的模式、提示、重试指令和提取设置。 候选人通过结构检查——包括计划有效性、参考完整性、时间和因果一致性以及覆盖面——与对事实准确性、完整性、相关性、忠诚性、一致性和整体质量进行评分的LLM法官一起进行评估。 成本的计量方法是,在有代号时进行计数,而API则另行计数。 GEPA使用度量衡和观察到的失败来提出突变,并在质量-成本-帕雷托前沿保留非主导配置. 两个阶段的提取器和GEPA优化循环载于附录图2和图3。

blocks.en: We also evaluate a Generative FrameNet-guided configuration ( Tayyar Madabushi et al., 2025 ) , using frame hints such as hiring, retaliation, and termination to guide event typing.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估了Generative FrameworkNet(Tayyar Madabushi等人,2025年)指导的配置,利用雇用、报复和终止等框架提示指导事件打字。

blocks.en: Mini-graphs are first combined through deterministic merging. Entity identifiers are remapped into a document-level namespace, and mentions with the same lowercased, whitespace-normalized name are assigned to the same entity. Events are deduplicated using a structured key containing event type, normalized main verb, temporal value, participant entity–role pairs, and supporting sentence identifiers. Duplicate records accumulate their source references, and existing intra-chunk edges are remapped to the resulting document-level event identifiers.
blocks.zh: 迷你图首先通过定型合并进行合并. 实体标识符被重新映射到文档级别的命名空间,并用相同的小写提及,白空间规范化名称被分配到同一个实体. 事件使用结构化的密钥进行复制,该密钥包含事件类型,规范化的主动词,时间值,参与者实体–角色对,以及支持句子标识符. 复制记录累积其源引用,现有的圆柱内边缘被重新映射到由此产生的文件级事件标识符上.

blocks.en: ARGUS then performs LLM-assisted cross-chunk resolution. Candidate pairs are restricted to events originating from different chunks and ranked by similarity over their event descriptions and contextual evidence. For each candidate, the LLM determines whether the records describe the same occurrence and whether a supported temporal or causal relation should be added. The prompt favors precision and returns no relation when evidence is insufficient. Duplicate events may be collapsed, after which existing edges are remapped and accepted cross-chunk relations are added.
blocks.zh: 然后,ARGUS进行LLM辅助的跨整流分辨率。 候选人配对仅限于来自不同块的事件,并按事件描述和背景证据的相似程度排序。 对于每个候选人,LLM决定记录是否描述同一事件,以及是否应当添加一个支持的时间或因果关系. 迅速有利于精确度,在证据不足时不返回关系。 重复事件可能崩溃,之后对现有边缘进行重新映射,并添加被接受的跨圆关系.

blocks.en: Fact extraction is evaluated by comparing LEGAL-BERT and LexLM with a prompted GPT-5 baseline, using Fact-class F1 as the primary metric and accuracy, precision, and recall as supporting measures. Mini-graph extraction is evaluated on a fixed 24-chunk set using automatic structural and semantic measures and human annotation. Four annotators inspect each graph with its source text and assign Aligned , Partially Aligned , or Misaligned , together with an error tag and explanation when applicable. We report percent agreement, Fleiss’ κ \kappa , and Krippendorff’s α \alpha .
blocks.zh: 通过将Legal-BERT和LexLM与GPT-5基准相比较,以F1级作为主要衡量尺度和准确性、精确度以及召回度作为辅助措施,对事实提取进行评估。 使用自动结构和语义计量和人文注释,在固定的24个圆形集上对微型图提取进行评估。 4名注释员检查每个图表的源文本,并指定对齐、部分对齐或错配,同时酌情指定错误标记和解释。 我们报告百分率协议,Fleiss的 \ kappa 和 Krippendorff 的 α α 。

blocks.en: Document-level construction is compared with a one-shot Claude Sonnet 4.5 baseline that generates a complete EKG directly from the full FACTS narrative; the exact prompt is provided in Appendix B.1 . Three LLM judges—DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3-Coder, and Mistral-Large—compare the staged and one-shot graphs on event grounding, evidence grounding, edge correctness, and overall quality. We additionally report inter-judge agreement, Gwet’s AC1 ( Gwet, 2008 ) , and stability under temperature variation (Appendix B.2 , Table 11 ). Multiple judges complement human annotation and reduce reliance on a single evaluator ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . U.S. holdout results are reported in Appendix B.4 , Table 12 .
blocks.zh: 文件级构造与一发Claude Sonnet 4.5基线比较,该基准直接从FACTS的完整叙述中产生完整的EKG;准确的提示载于附录B.1. 三位LLM评委——DeepSeek-R1、Qune3-Coder和Mistral-Large——比较了舞台和一弹一弹的图表,涉及事件地面、证据地面、边缘正确性和整体质量。 我们还报告法官之间的协议,Gwet的AC1(Gwet,2008年)和温度变化下的稳定性(附录B.2,表11)。 多名法官补充了人的注释,减少了对单一评价者的依赖(郑等人,2023年)。 附录B.4表12报告了美国拒收结果。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We collect 153 employment-discrimination complaints (Nature of Suit 442, Civil Employment Cases) from CourtListener, 3 3 3 https://www.courtlistener.com/ an open legal-search repository maintained by the Free Law Project.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了153起就业歧视投诉 3 3 https://www.courtlistener.com/免费法律项目维护的开放法律搜索库。

blocks.en: A complaint is the initiating pleading filed by a plaintiff and describes allegations rather than facts established by a court. Accordingly, the events represented by ARGUS reflect the allegations contained in the complaint and should not be interpreted as adjudicated findings.
blocks.zh: 申诉是原告提出的诉状,陈述指控而不是法院确定的事实。 因此,ARGUS代表的事件反映了申诉中的指控,不应被解释为裁定的结果。

blocks.en: The raw filings are OCR-derived scanned court documents with no gold labels for facts, events, or case similarity. We retrieve them through a Selenium-based pipeline and preprocess them using OCR-to-text conversion, header/footer and boilerplate removal, section detection, sentence segmentation, and normalization. Section detection isolates the FACTS narrative from jurisdictional and prayer-for-relief text.
blocks.zh: 原始档案是OCR扫描的法院文件,没有关于事实、事件或案件相似性的金色标签。 我们通过一个基于硒的管道回收它们, 并用OCR到文本的转换, 头/脚和锅炉板的去除, 区段检测, 句子分割, 以及正常化来进行预处理。 检查科将FACTS的叙述与司法管辖和祈祷救济文本隔离开来.

blocks.en: The corpus covers five U.S. district courts to include jurisdiction-specific writing variation (Table 1 ): Eastern District of Pennsylvania (EAPD), Eastern District of Kentucky (KYED), Southern District of New York (NYSD), Western District of Pennsylvania (PAWD), and District of Rhode Island (RID). Documents vary substantially in length and structure. Where sentence-level annotation is complete, the fact rate ranges from 81.7% (KYED) to 93.0% (PAWD). All splits are defined at the document level to prevent boilerplate and near-duplicate leakage; sentence-level fact extraction inherits its parent document split, while mini-graph extraction and merging are inference-only.
blocks.zh: 案卷范围包括五个美国地区法院,包括具体管辖权的书写变化(表1):宾夕法尼亚州东部区(EAPD),肯塔基州东部区(KYED),纽约州南部区(NYSD),宾夕法尼亚州西部区(PAWD),罗德岛区(RID). 文件的长度和结构差别很大。 如果刑期说明完成,实际比率从81.7%(KYED)到93.0%(PAWD)。 所有拆分在文件级别上被定义,以防止锅炉板和近重复的渗漏;句子级别的事实提取继承其母文件的拆分,而微型图提取和合并只是推论.

blocks.zh: 表1:各区数据集统计。 事实率(Fact rate)是标注事实的句子的一小部分;对于EAPD来说,句级注释尚未完成.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation of Graph Construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 对图表建设的评价

blocks.en: We fine-tune LEGAL-BERT and LexLM for sentence-level Fact/Non-Fact classification and compare them with a prompted GPT-5 baseline on a fixed 100-sentence U.S. gold sample (Table 2 ). Fact-class F1 is the primary metric, with accuracy, precision, and recall also reported. LEGAL-BERT achieves the highest F1 (0.7273) and precision (0.8889), while GPT-5 achieves substantially higher recall (0.9231). This precision–recall complementarity motivates the hybrid fallback described in Section 3 . On the U.S. holdout, classifier-only and hybrid modes perform similarly (F1 ≈ 0.87 \approx 0.87 for LEGAL-BERT and ≈ 0.86 \approx 0.86 for LexLM), whereas LLM-only extraction is weaker (F1 ≈ 0.71 \approx 0.71 – 0.72 0.72 ; see Appendix B.4 , Table 12 ).
Table 2: Fact-extraction results on a fixed 100-sentence U.S. gold sample. LEGAL-BERT and LexLM are fine-tuned legal-domain encoders; GPT-5 is a prompted baseline. Fact is the positive class.
blocks.zh: 表2: 固定100刑金样本的实测结果. Law-BERT和LexLM是微调的法律领域编码器;GPT-5是一个提示基线。 事实就是正面的课。

blocks.en: We evaluate mini-graph extraction on a fixed 24-chunk set. Claude Sonnet 4.5 + GEPA achieves a quality score of 0.896, with schema validity and coverage of 1.0; causal self-loops are the main residual structural error. Among open-source alternatives (Table 3 ), Qwen achieves higher semantic quality and produces more events and relations per chunk, while GPT-OSS-120B scores slightly higher on structural and temporal-consistency measures.
blocks.zh: 我们评估一个固定的 24 个中集的小型图提取。 克劳德·索内 4.5 + GEPA的质量分数为0.896,计划有效性和覆盖范围为1.0;因果自律是主要的残余结构错误. 在开源替代品(表3)中,Quen实现了更高的语义质量,并且每块产生更多的事件和关系,而GPT-OSS-120B在结构和时间一致性措施上的得分略高.

blocks.en: For human evaluation, four team members independently review each mini-graph with its source text and assign Aligned , Partially Aligned , or Misaligned , plus a free-text explanation and, when applicable, an error tag such as missing event, wrong role, or hallucinated detail. We report percent agreement, Fleiss’ κ \kappa , and Krippendorff’s α \alpha (Table 4 ). The FrameNet-guided Qwen configuration reaches 85.2% Aligned and Fleiss’ κ = 0.669 \kappa=0.669 , compared with 78.3% and κ = 0.143 \kappa=0.143 for the Claude configuration. Because model choice and FrameNet guidance vary together, this is a configuration-level comparison rather than an isolated FrameNet ablation.
blocks.zh: 对于人类评价,四位团队成员独立审查每张迷你图及其源文本,并指定Acet ,部分对齐,或Misacontion,外加自由文本解释,并在适用的情况下,指定一个错误标记,如缺失事件,错误角色,或幻觉细节. 我们报告百分率协议,Fleiss的 $\kappa, 和Krippendorff的 α\ alpha(表4). FrameNet制导的Qwen配置达到85.2%的Aconition和Fleiss的0.669\kappa=0.669,而克劳德配置为78.3%,0.143\kappa=0.143。 因为模型选择和FrameNet的引导在一起是不同的,所以这是一种配置层次的比较,而不是孤立的FrameNet bulling.

blocks.zh: 表3:小图提取的开源模型比较.

blocks.en: We first measure how document-level merging changes graph size on five validation documents. Table 5 shows that event counts are almost entirely preserved: only one event is removed across the five cases. Entity counts decrease substantially in four cases as repeated mentions are consolidated into document-level entities. This provides a structural check before comparison with a one-shot baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在五个验证文件中衡量文档层面合并变化图大小。 表5显示,事件计数几乎完全保留:在五个案件中,只有一个事件被删除。 在四起案件中,实体数目大幅减少,因为一再提及已并入文件一级实体。 这在与一发基线进行比较之前提供了结构检查。

blocks.en: Table 5: Event and entity counts before and after document-level merging on five validation cases.
blocks.zh: 表5:事件和实体在文件一级合并之前和之后对5个审定案件进行计算。

blocks.en: We then compare ARGUS with a one-shot baseline in which Claude Sonnet 4.5, accessed through an OpenAI-compatible hosted API, generates a complete document-level EKG directly from the full FACTS section, without semantic chunking, intermediate mini-graphs, or staged merging. The exact prompt is provided in Appendix B.1 . The baseline extracts no events for two of five validation documents and varies substantially in coverage on the others (Table 6 ), demonstrating the difficulty of performing event extraction and relational reasoning over the complete narrative in one generation.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将ARGUS与一个一击基线进行对比,Claude Sonnet 4.5通过一个兼容的OpenAI主机API访问,直接从完整的FACTS部分生成一个完整的文件级的EKG,没有语义分割,中间的迷你图,或者进行合并. 具体时间见附录B.1。 基线对5份鉴定文件中的2份没有提取事件,对其他文件的涵盖范围也有很大差异(表6),表明在一代人的时间里很难对完整的叙述进行事件提取和关系推理。

blocks.en: Table 6: One-shot LLM baseline event-graph extraction on the five merger-validation documents.
blocks.zh: 表6:5份兼并认证文件中的一弹一弹LLM基线事件图提取.

blocks.en: Three LLM judges—DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3-Coder, and Mistral-Large—compare the one-shot and staged graphs on event grounding, evidence grounding, edge correctness, and overall quality. ARGUS is preferred on evidence grounding, edge correctness, and overall quality in all comparisons and on event grounding in 93.3% of comparisons (all p = 0.031 p=0.031 ; Table 7 ). Intra-model stability under temperature variation is 100% for Qwen and Mistral and 80% for DeepSeek-R1 (Appendix B.2 , Table 11 ).
blocks.zh: 三位LLM评委——Deep Seek-R1、Qune3-Coder和Mistral-Large——比较了事件地面、证据地面、边缘正确性和整体质量的一弹一弹和舞台图表。 在所有比较中,在证据依据、边缘正确性和整体质量方面,以及在93.3%的比较中,在事件依据方面,更倾向于ARGUS(所有p=0.031p=0.031;表7)。 气温变化下的模型内稳定性对Quen和Mistral来说是100%,对DeepSeek-R1来说是80%(附录B.2,表11)。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments on Downstream Tasks
blocks.zh: 5次关于下游任务的实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Classification
blocks.zh: 5.1 分类

blocks.en: We formulate claim-type prediction as multi-label classification over 23 concepts from the SALI Alliance’s Legal Matter Specification Standard (LMSS) 4 4 4 The LMSS is available at https://sali.org/explore-the-standard/ . across 130 complaints (176 label assignments), using LLM-generated silver labels reviewed by humans. We compare three representations over the same label space: the preprocessed complaint text encoded from a 512-token input, a linearized entity/event EKG, and a graph-structured EKG using participation, temporal, and causal edges. Raw text provides a text baseline; the linearized EKG tests whether graph topology adds value beyond serialization of the extracted graph.
blocks.zh: 我们从萨利联盟的法律事项规格标准(LMSS)4 4 4 将权利要求类型预测作为多标签分类。 在130个投诉(176个标签任务)中,使用LLM生成的经人类审查的银色标签。 我们在同一标签空间上比较了三个表示:由512个输入编码的预处理投诉文本、一个线性实体/活动EKG,以及一个使用参与、时间和因果边缘的图形结构的EKG。 原始文本提供了一个文本基线;线性化的EKG测试了图表地形是否在所提取的图表的序列化之外增加了价值.

blocks.en: On the 22-document held-out test set (Micro-F1@0.5; Table 8 ), the raw-text and linearized-EKG LEGAL-BERT models obtain 0.590 0.590 and 0.583 0.583 , respectively, while the graph-structured EKG-GNN reaches 0.642. This is an absolute gain of 0.052 Micro-F1, or 8.8% relative to the raw-text baseline. The graph-structured representation therefore performs best on this held-out set.
blocks.zh: 在22个文件被搁置的测试组(Micro-F1@0.5;表8)上,原始文本和线化的EKG Law-BERT模型分别获得0.590 0.590和0.583 0.583,而图结构的EKG-GN则达到0.642. 这是0.052微F1的绝对增益,相对于原始文本基线为8.8%. 因此,图表结构化的表述在这套搁置中表现最好。

blocks.zh: 表8:22个有文件证明的搁置测试包的SALI索赔类型分类。

blocks.en: 5.2 Clustering vs. Distance
blocks.zh: 5.2 集群与距离

blocks.en: Each merged EKG is reduced to Core6D: log-counts of entities, events, temporal edges, and causal edges, plus graph density and temporal-edge ratio. The vectors are L2-normalized and clustered with K K -means. We use the silhouette score to compare graph-derived representations with a TF-IDF bag-of-words baseline and to evaluate alternative values of K K .
blocks.zh: 每个合并的EKG被缩小为Core6D:实体的对数,事件,时间边,和因果边,加上图密度和时间边尖比. 矢量是L2-正态的,与K K - 意思组合在一起. 我们用Silhouette的分数来比较图表表达法和TF-IDF的词包基线,并评价K K的替代值。

blocks.en: Core6D reaches a silhouette score of 0.649 at K = 4 K=4 , compared with 0.091 for TF-IDF, 0.363 for the full high-dimensional EKG representation, and 0.465 for Legacy7D. Although the K = 2 K=2 – 40 40 sweep favors very small K K , we use K = 4 K=4 to retain stronger granularity with high cohesion. Compact structural summaries therefore produce substantially cleaner cluster geometry than TF-IDF or the unreduced EKG representation at this corpus size. Full results are reported in Appendix C , Table 13 .
blocks.zh: Core6D在K = 4 K = 4 时达到 0.649 的分数,与之相比,TF-IDF的分数为 0.091,全高维 EKG 的分数为 0.363,而Legacy7D的分数为 0.465. 虽然K = 2 K = 2 – 40 40 横扫优惠非常小的K K,但我们使用K = 4 K = 4 来保留更强的颗粒性,具有高度的凝聚力. 因此,与TF-IDF或这种实体规模的未减少的EKG代表值相比,压缩结构摘要产生了非常清洁的集群几何学。 全部结果载于附录C表13。

blocks.en: We compare three Core6D-based configurations using distance to the assigned centroid and an independent LLM-judged cluster-membership score. Run A combines SALI claim tags with Core6D and produces one dominant cluster (111/14/6/2), with Pearson r ≈ − 0.06 r\approx-0.06 between centroid distance and judged membership. Run B augments Core6D with a 16-dimensional PCA-compressed EKG-context embedding, producing more balanced clusters, with Pearson r ≈ − 0.28 r\approx-0.28 and Spearman ρ ≈ − 0.31 \rho\approx-0.31 . Run C adds SALI tags and a k k NN graph-neighbor block to Run B, reaching Pearson r ≈ − 0.29 r\approx-0.29 and Spearman ρ ≈ − 0.37 \rho\approx-0.37 , without clearly outperforming Run B.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了3个基于Core6D的配置,利用了与分配的中间行星的距离,以及一个独立的LLM判断的集群成员分数. 运行 A将 SALI 索赔标记与 Core6D 结合,并产生一个主控集群(111/14/6/2),与 Pearson r ≈ − − 0.06 r\ 0.06 介于离中心行星距离和判断成员之间. 运行 B 增强 Core6D 并使用 16 维的 PCA 压缩 EKG 文本嵌入,生成更平衡的集群,其中 Pearson r → − 0.28 r\ 大约0.28 r\ 大约0. 28 和 Spearman ë → − − 0.31\rho\ 大约0.31 。 运行 C 添加了 SALI 标记和一个 k k NN 图邻块到运行 B , 到达 Pearson r → − 0.29 r\\ 大约 0. 29 和 Spearman → → − 0. 37 \rho\ 大约 0. 37 , 但没有明显超过运行 B 。

blocks.en: The pattern indicates that continuous EKG-derived context contributes more clustering signal than SALI claim tags alone, while the additional Run C components provide limited further benefit. Validation uses geometric and LLM-judged membership diagnostics rather than attorney relevance judgments. Detailed feature definitions, ablations, and plots are provided in Appendix C (Tables 14 – 15 and Figures 5 – 7 ).
blocks.zh: 该图案表明,持续的EKG派生上下文比仅SALI索赔标记更有助于集群信号,而额外的Run C组件提供的进一步好处有限. 验证采用几何学和LLM判断的成员诊断法,而不是律师相关判决. 附录C(表14-15和图5-7)提供了详细的特征定义、拼图和地块。

blocks.en: 5.3 Document-Scoped Question Answering
blocks.zh: 5.3 文件范围问题回答

blocks.en: We build a 300-question FAQ benchmark over 10 CourtListener employment-discrimination complaints (30 questions per document), spanning four graph-relevant question types: temporal order (what occurred before or after an event), causal/enablement (what allegedly caused or enabled an event), temporal overlap (whether two events were concurrent), and party resolution (who did what to whom), plus a small residual temporal-relation category. Each question has a gold answer grounded in its source complaint.
blocks.zh: 我们为10项法院听取者就业歧视投诉(每份文件30个问题)制定了300个问题FAQ基准,涉及四个与图表相关的问题类型:时间顺序(事件发生前或事件发生后发生的情况)、因果关系(据称造成或促成的事件)、时间重叠(两个事件是否同时发生)和当事方决议(谁对谁做什么),以及少量剩余时间关系类别。 每个问题都有一个黄金答案 来源于它的抱怨。

blocks.en: Holding GPT-4o and the answering prompt fixed, we compare three retrieval conditions:
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三个检索条件:

blocks.en: 1. Raw document — the FACTS section is chunked and retrieved directly, without graph structure. 2. Hybrid text + EKG — linearized document-level EKG context is combined with retrieved raw-text context. 3. EKG only — the linearized EKG is used without raw-text context.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 原始文档 – FACTS 部分是直接块并检索的,没有图表结构. 2. 混合文本 + EKG – 线性化文档级 EKG 语境与检索的原始文本语境结合. 3. EKG只——无原始文字上下文使用线性化的EKG.

blocks.en: Raw document — the FACTS section is chunked and retrieved directly, without graph structure.
blocks.zh: 原始文档 – FACTS 部分是直接块并检索的,没有图表结构.

blocks.en: Hybrid text + EKG — linearized document-level EKG context is combined with retrieved raw-text context.
blocks.zh: 混合文本 + EKG – 线性文档级 EKG 语境与被检索的原始文本语境结合.

blocks.en: EKG only — the linearized EKG is used without raw-text context.
blocks.zh: 只有EKG——线性化的EKG在没有原始文本上下文的情况下使用.

blocks.en: Answer quality is measured with Token-F1 against the gold answer. Because each question is paired with its source complaint, this is a within-document retrieval experiment: it evaluates representation and reasoning after the relevant document is known, not first-stage retrieval across CourtListener.
blocks.zh: 答题质量与Token-F1对照黄金答题进行测量. 由于每个问题都与其来源投诉联系起来,因此这是一个文件内检索试验:在知道相关文件之后,它评价表述和推理,而不是在法庭旁听者的第一阶段检索。

blocks.en: EKG-only retrieval achieves 0.446 mean Token-F1, compared with 0.323 for raw text and 0.363 for hybrid text + EKG (Table 9 ), absolute gains of 0.123 and 0.083, respectively. Hybrid improves over raw text by 0.040, but adding raw context reduces performance relative to EKG alone. This pattern is consistent with additional unstructured context introducing noise, although the experiment does not isolate that mechanism.
blocks.zh: 仅EKG的检索实现0.446平均Token-F1,而原始文本为0.323,混合文本+EKG为0.363(表9),绝对收益分别为0.123和0.083. Hybrids比原始文本改进了0.040,但添加原始上下文会降低单与EKG相比的性能. 这种模式与引入噪音的其他无结构上下文是一致的,尽管实验并不孤立这种机制.

blocks.en: Table 9: Document-scoped FAQ answer quality over 300 questions from 10 CourtListener complaints (GPT-4o).
blocks.zh: 表9:从10项法庭听取者投诉(GPT-4o)中解答300多个问题的质量问题。

blocks.en: The EKG gain over raw text is largest for temporal order (0.381 → \to 0.538, + 0.157 +0.157 ) and causal/enablement (0.387 → \to 0.522, + 0.134 +0.134 ), categories directly aligned with graph relations. Temporal-overlap questions also improve substantially (0.241 → \to 0.384, + 0.143 +0.143 ). The smallest improvement is for party resolution (0.152 → \to 0.197, + 0.045 +0.045 ), where participant names and mentions are already accessible in source text. Full question-type results are reported in Appendix D.1 , Table 16 .
blocks.zh: 与原始文本相比,EKG增益最大,用于时间顺序(0.381 →\至0.538,+ 0.157 + 0.157)和因果关系(0.387 →\至0.522,+ 0.34 + 0.134),与图表关系直接对齐的类别. 临时重叠问题也大有改进(0.241 →\至0.384,+0.143+0.143),最小的改进是缔约方的解析(0.152 →\至0.197,+0.045+0.045),其中参与者姓名和提及在来源文本中已经可以查阅。 完整的问题类结果见附录D.1,表16。

blocks.en: We test the n = 299 n=299 questions scored under all three conditions; one failed hybrid LLM call is excluded from all three arms to preserve pairing. We use a paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval over the mean F1 difference (10,000 resamples), Wilcoxon signed-rank test, and sign-flip paired permutation test (10,000 permutations).
blocks.zh: 我们测试在三个条件下得分的n = 299 n = 299个问题;一个失败的混合LLM呼叫被排除在所有三个臂中以保留配对. 我们在平均F1差值(10,000个复标),Wilcoxon 签名排名测试和标志-flip配对长程测试(10,000个长程测试)上使用一对靴子95%的置信间隔.

EKG-only exceeds raw text by + 0.123 +0.123 F1 ( p < 10 − 30 p<10^{-30} ) and hybrid by + 0.083 +0.083 ( p < 10 − 20 p<10^{-20} ), while hybrid exceeds raw text by + 0.040 +0.040 ( p < 10 − 10 p<10^{-10} ). Bootstrap confidence intervals and exact Wilcoxon results are reported in Appendix D.1 , Table 17 .

The residual temporal-relation category contains three questions and is not significant ( p = 0.25 p=0.25 ); full results are reported in Appendix D.1 , Table 18 .

blocks.en: 6 Generalization to External Datasets
blocks.zh: 6 通用到外部数据集

blocks.en: To test generalization beyond the employment-complaint FAQ benchmark, we evaluate on Multistate Bar Examination (MBE) multiple-choice questions ( RegLab, Stanford University, 2024 ) . We report two experiments with different retrieval setups and corpus scales; they are evaluated separately.
blocks.zh: 为了测试通用性超越就业投诉的FAQ基准,我们评价了多州律师考试(MBE)的多选题(RegLab,斯坦福大学,2024年). 我们报告两项实验,使用不同的检索设置和体积;它们分别评估。

blocks.en: 6.1 Experiment A: Retrieval-Condition Comparison
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验A:检索-条件比较

blocks.en: We evaluate 117 MBE questions, each containing a fact pattern, four answer choices, and a gold supporting passage drawn from 100 short appellate opinion excerpts. Unlike the FAQ benchmark, the task selects an answer choice (A–D) rather than generating free text, and its passages contain legal holdings and reasoning rather than narrative complaints. We compare raw document, chunked text, and EKG graph retrieval (top 3 passages each), holding Claude Sonnet 5 fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们评价117个MBE问题,每个问题都包含一个事实模式,四个答案选择,以及来自100个简短上诉意见摘录的黄金支持段落. 与FAQ基准不同,任务选择一个答案选择(A–D)而不是生成免费文本,其段落包含法律持有和推理,而不是叙述性抱怨. 我们比较原始文档,块形文本,以及EKG图检索(每个上3段),持有Claude Sonnet 5固定.

blocks.en: Raw document retrieval reaches 85.47% accuracy, while chunked text and EKG retrieval both reach 86.32%, a 0.85 percentage-point gain (Table 19 ). Among the 100 questions with an available gold-source EKG, EKG accuracy is 86.00%.
blocks.zh: 原始文件检索达到85.47%的准确度,而块状文本和EKG检索均达到86.32%,增幅为0.85个百分点(表19)。 在具有可用金源EKG的100个问题中,EKG精度为86.00%.

blocks.en: We use exact McNemar tests, paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (10,000 resamples), and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. No pairwise comparison is significant: all McNemar p p -values exceed 0.68 and all bootstrap intervals include zero. Only 6–9 outcomes differ between any pair of conditions. Full statistics are reported in Appendix D.2 , Table 20 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用精确的McNemar测试,配对的靴子 95%的置信间隔(10,000个复标),和威尔科克森签名排名测试。 没有双向比较是显著的:所有McNemar p - 值超过0.68,所有靴子间隔包括0. 任何一对条件之间只有6-9个结果不同。 完整统计数据见附录D.2,表20。

blocks.en: The lack of a significant retrieval-condition difference contrasts with the larger gains on document-scoped FAQ (Section 5.3 ), where improvements are strongest for temporal order, causality, and enablement. Experiment A instead yields nearly identical chunked-text and EKG performance. EKG benefits therefore depend on the information required by the task rather than holding uniformly across legal QA.
blocks.zh: 缺乏重大的检索条件差异与文件范围财务调查表(第5.3节)的较大进展形成对比,在时间顺序、因果关系和赋能方面改进最强。 实验 取而代之的是几乎相同的块形文字和EKG性能。 因此,EKG的好处取决于任务所要求的信息,而不是在法律质量保证中统一持有。

blocks.en: 6.2 Experiment B: Open-Retrieval and Oracle-Document Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.2 实验B:开放检索和甲骨文文件分析

blocks.en: We evaluate 100 MBE-style multiple-choice questions from the legal_bench subset, retrieving from the reglab/barexam_qa corpus of 856,835 legal passages. Claude Sonnet 4.5 selects the final answer (A–D). We first measure open-retrieval Recall@10 and then downstream multiple-choice accuracy. BM25 and E5-large-v2 search the full corpus directly; hybrid Graph-RAG reranks the BM25 top-1,000 candidate set using graph-relevance scores where available.
blocks.zh: 我们评价100个 MBE 风格的多选择问题, Claude Sonnet 4.5选择了最后的答案(A–D). 我们首先测量开放-检索回调@10,然后下游多选精度。 BM25和E5大V2直接搜索全体;混合Graph-RAG对BM25顶级1000选手集的排名进行了重新排序,在有图相关分的情况下使用图相关分.

blocks.en: BM25 and E5 retrieve the gold passage in the top ten for 1% of questions, while hybrid Graph-RAG reaches 8% Recall@10 (Table 10 ). The gold passage appears in the BM25 top-1,000 pool for eight questions, and graph reranking moves all eight into the final top ten. The Recall@10 gain therefore occurs when first-stage retrieval has already placed the relevant passage in the candidate pool; graph reranking cannot recover passages absent from that pool.
blocks.zh: BM25和E5为1%的问题检索前十的黄金通道,而混合图-RAG则达到8%的回调@10(表10). 黄金通道出现在BM25前1000位的游泳池中,用于8个题材,图则将所有8个题材重新排位,进入最终的前十名. 因此,当第一阶段检索已经将相关段落放入候选集合时,就会出现“召回@10”收益;图表重新排序无法收回该集合中缺失的段落。

blocks.en: Table 10: Open-retrieval performance on the 100-question Bar Exam QA subset.
blocks.zh: 表10:百题酒吧考试QA子集的开放检索性能.

blocks.en: BM25-RAG achieves 73% accuracy and open Graph-RAG 72%, both below the 76% no-passage baseline (Table 21 ). The gold-passage condition reaches 79%, showing that relevant evidence improves answer selection. In the open setting, however, the gold passage is absent from most retrieved contexts, so first-stage retrieval errors limit the downstream value of graph reranking.
blocks.zh: BM25-RAG的精确度达到73%,开放的Graph-RAG达到72%,均低于76%的无通道基线(表21)。 黄金通道条件达到79%,表明相关证据改善了答案选择. 然而,在开放的设置中,大多数检索到的上下文都缺少黄金通道,因此第一阶段检索错误限制了图重排的下游值.

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate Graph-RAG when the relevant source document is known. The original configuration reaches 75% accuracy but produces empty graph retrievals for 18 questions. A revised configuration adds document-scoped retrieval, an MCQ-specific prompt, and hybrid context combining the gold passage with graph evidence, reaching 82%. Because these changes are introduced together, the 82% result is a configuration-level comparison rather than a graph-only ablation.
blocks.zh: 在得知相关来源文件后,我们还要对图-RAG进行评估。 原始配置达到75%的精度,但生成18个问题的空图检索. 修改后的配置增加了文档范围检索,一个MCQ特异性的快速,以及混合上下文将黄金通道与图表证据结合,达到82%. 由于这些变化是一起引入的,因此82%的结果是配置级别比较,而不是只用图表表示.

blocks.en: These experiments separate first-stage retrieval from downstream use of structured evidence. Graph reranking raises open Recall@10 from 1% to 8%, but relevant passages enter the BM25 top-1,000 candidate pool for only eight of 100 questions, limiting downstream gains. In the oracle-document setting, the revised configuration reaches 82%, but it changes retrieval scope, prompting, and context together. The results support EKG structure for organizing and reasoning over already-relevant evidence rather than replacing first-stage full-corpus retrieval.
blocks.zh: 这些实验将第一阶段检索与结构化证据的下游使用分开。 图表重排将开放的Recall@10从1%提升至8%,但相关段落进入BM25前1000名候选组合,只为100题中的8题,限制了下游收益. 在Oracle-文档设置中,修改后的配置达到了82%,但它会改变检索范围,提示,以及上下文在一起. 结果支持EKG结构对已经相关的证据进行组织和推理,而不是取代第一阶段的全公司检索。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented ARGUS, a staged pipeline for converting U.S. employment-discrimination complaints into source-grounded Event Knowledge Graphs. The strongest gains occur when tasks exploit participant, temporal, or causal structure: the graph-structured classifier achieves higher held-out Micro-F1 than raw and linearized baselines, and EKG-only document-scoped retrieval improves FAQ answer quality. The bar-exam experiments provide a boundary condition: Experiment A shows no significant retrieval-condition difference, while open-retrieval gains occur only when relevant passages enter the first-stage candidate pool. ARGUS therefore supports organizing and reasoning over relevant legal evidence rather than replacing first-stage retrieval.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了ARGUS,这是将美国就业歧视投诉转化为以源头为基础的事件知识图的分阶段管道。 最强增益发生在任务利用参与者,时间,或因果结构时:图形结构的分类器实现比原始和线性基线更高的持有量微F1,只有EKG的文档范围检索可以提高FAQ解答质量. bar-exam实验提供了一个边界条件: 实验 A显示检索条件没有显著差异,而开放检索收益只有在相关段落进入第一阶段候选人人才库时才会出现。 因此,阿根廷支持对相关法律证据进行组织和推理,而不是取代第一阶段检索。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The corpus contains 153 U.S. federal employment-discrimination complaints from five districts and does not establish generalization to other claims, jurisdictions, or legal genres. Several evaluations use small samples: 24 chunks for mini-graph quality, five documents for the merger comparison, and 100–117 questions for the bar-exam studies. The FAQ benchmark is document-scoped, and the clustering analysis has no attorney relevance judgments, so neither establishes end-to-end similar-case retrieval. Human graph evaluation was performed by four project members rather than legal practitioners, and LLM judges may share biases with the systems they evaluate. OCR, extraction, coreference, and inferred temporal or causal errors can propagate. Finally, the configuration yielding the 82% oracle-document result changes retrieval scope, prompting, and context together and should not be interpreted as a graph-only ablation.
blocks.zh: 书中写着: 153 美国联邦5个区的就业歧视投诉,没有确立对其他权利主张,管辖权,或法律流派的概括. 一些评价使用小样本:24块用于微型图质量,5份用于合并比较的文件,100-117个用于条形图研究的问题。 FAQ基准是文件范围,集群分析没有律师相关判断,因此也没有建立端对端类似案例检索. 人图评价由四个项目成员而不是法律从业人员进行,LLM法官可能与其评价的系统有偏见。 OCR、提取、校对和推断出的时间或因果错误可以传播。 最后,生成 82% oracle- document 结果的配置会改变检索范围、 提示和上下文, 并且不应该被解释为只使用图表的缩写 。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Court complaints are public records but contain names and sensitive allegations. Automatically extracted roles, events, and causal relations can be incomplete or wrong and should not be treated as legal findings or used without attorney review. Any artifact release should follow the source repository’s terms, minimize unnecessary personal information, and state clearly that ARGUS is a research prototype for retrieval and organization rather than legal advice.
blocks.zh: 法院申诉是公开记录,但载有姓名和敏感指控。 自动提取的角色,事件和因果关系可能不完整或错误,不应作为法律结论对待,或未经律师审查使用. 任何文物的释放都应遵循来源库的规定,尽量减少不必要的个人信息,并明确指出ARGUS是检索和组织的研究原型,而不是法律咨询。
